description: Change an Assistant assignment's prompt, start, recurrence or time zone. Fields left out keep their value.

startsAt.description: First run, ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. "2026-11-16T08:00:00+01:00"

timezone.description: IANA time zone the recurrence follows, e.g. "Europe/Berlin" (default: the user's zone)

name: update_assistant_assignment
title: Update Assistant Assignment
